info.title: NK Fashion API
info.description:
REST API for NK Fashion products, variants, categories, brands, metals, and individually tracked jewellery items.

**Local Development Notes:**
- Default HTTP URL: `http://localhost:5173`
- Default HTTPS URL: `https://localhost:7211`
- Interactive Swagger UI (when API is running): `http://localhost:5173/swagger`
- Live Swagger OpenAPI JSON: `http://localhost:5173/swagger/v1/swagger.json`
- Enum fields use integer values unless noted otherwise (for example, `JewelleryItemResponse.status` returns a string such as `"InStock"`).
